srList.sentence: Background and overview of World Health Organization (WHO) working group procedures Pregnant women and infants under six months of age are among the population subgroups considered to be at high risk for serious influenza-related morbidity and mortality [1–10].

sentenceParts.c: Background and overview of World Health Organization (WHO) working group procedures Pregnant women and infants under six months of age are among the population subgroups considered to be at high risk for serious influenza-related morbidity and mortality [1–10].

srList.sentence: Evidence assembled included existing systematic reviews, randomized clinical trials (RCTs) of influenza vaccination in pregnancy (three of which were published during the lifespan of this working group [16,27,28]), and other publications (e.g., highly-cited studies relevant to influenza virus infection or immunization during pregnancy).
